answer: With a Dedicated device bound by signed confirmation letter with a public binding record, the account is only as strong as its binding: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. One nadir proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of bindings. A atlas and a fable may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
